name: Echo CS-400
blurb: 40.2 cc homeowner saw on 3/8″ low-profile chain. Oregon's data: 16″ bar, .050″ gauge, 56 drive links, 5/32″ file.
intro: The CS-400 is Echo's 40.2 cc homeowner saw, and like most saws in its class it runs 3/8″ low-profile chain — the smaller “Picco-class” profile, not the full-size 3/8″ of its bigger brother the CS-590. Oregon's product data for the chain it lists for this model gives the full spec for the 16″ setup, including the part most pages omit: the 5/32″ file size.

sources.title: Product data for 91VXL056G / 91PX056G (3/8″ Low Profile, .050″ gauge, 56 drive links, 5/32″ file; fitments include Echo CS-400; cross-references to Husqvarna H37-56 and Stihl 63 PM3 56)

sources_note: Oregon product data for 91VXL056G / 91PX056G (3/8″ Low Profile, .050″ gauge, 56 drive links, 5/32″ file; fitments include Echo CS-400), including published cross-references to Husqvarna H37-56 and Stihl 63 PM3 56 — checked Oct 2026.

bars.note: Per Oregon's product data: 91-series chain, 3/8″ LP, .050″, 56 DL, fits Echo CS-400 (and CS-310/352/370), file 5/32″. Cross-references include Husqvarna H37-56 and Stihl 63 PM3 56.
CS-400s are also sold with 18″ bars in North America. We list the count only where a chain-maker listing states it for this model — check your stamp, or count the links on the old loop.
